title: Paired replicated and content-addressed T1 state comparison

training_method.label: Three-step persisted sparse AdamW control
training_method.description: Three sequential frozen T1 batches advance real model and coordinator-owned AdamW state while refreshing shared hidden rows, routes, and expert trainable state.

execution_topology.label: Paired replicated and content-addressed local process controls
execution_topology.description: Each comparison runs the unchanged replicated full and pooled-expert trajectory plus a matched topology-local content-addressed candidate. The independent repeat reverses their order.

memory_profiles.label: Topology-local immutable checkpoint blobs
memory_profiles.description: Model and optimizer safetensors payloads are stored once by digest within each topology, while transaction pre-state and applied-state records retain canonical SHA-256 and byte-length references.

numerical_profiles.label: Python CPU FP32 exact control
numerical_profiles.description: One-thread PyTorch FP32 execution compares raw and clipped gradients, AdamW tensors, complete model tensors, losses, routes, transaction identities, and final state hashes exactly.

worker_profiles.label: Trusted local spawned process
worker_profiles.description: The coordinator uses one local spawned child at a time. Digest and durable-publication checks protect the local evidence boundary but do not authenticate an untrusted remote participant.

command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 uv run python -m orcacolony.artifacts --output .artifacts/p7-content-store-dataset

OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 uv run python -m orcacolony.sparse_expert_content_store --config campaign/t1-tinystories-system-proof.json --dataset .artifacts/p7-content-store-dataset --state .artifacts/p7-content-store-primary-state --steps 3 --expert-count 4 --router-aux-weight 0.01 --timeout-seconds 120 --sample-interval-seconds 0.01 --comparison-order replicated-then-content-addressed --output .artifacts/p7-content-store-primary.json

OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 uv run python -m orcacolony.sparse_expert_content_store --config campaign/t1-tinystories-system-proof.json --dataset .artifacts/p7-content-store-dataset --state .artifacts/p7-content-store-repeat-state --steps 3 --expert-count 4 --router-aux-weight 0.01 --timeout-seconds 120 --sample-interval-seconds 0.01 --comparison-order content-addressed-then-replicated --output .artifacts/p7-content-store-repeat.json
reproduction.notes: Run from merged revision c43c2cb5bb339e037ab48701f38a07d104b86de4, whose source tree matches implementation commit 2e0dcd6e82551330f87dedde8376539db3cd9899, on Linux with /proc. The data build must reproduce manifest SHA-256 99e5642bec2a9fa0b7f6175ed5f4821bf4f9aa2c08ec1038f12bfdfb302bb4af. Compare deterministic evidence fields exactly and treat elapsed times, RSS observations, sample counts, and timing-bearing JSON lengths as environmental. Each temporary comparison root is about 1.5 GB and may be removed after its evidence JSON is secured.
